[Historical GDP per capita for Europe and North America, 1300–2000](data/historical-gdp/index.qmd){.data-title}

Koch, P., Stojkoski, V., & Hidalgo, C. A. (2024). Augmenting the availability of historical GDP per capita estimates through machine learning. *Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences*, 121(39), e2402060121.

Machine-learning estimates of GDP per capita for 1,037 countries and regions, in 50-year steps over seven centuries, combined with the source data they were trained on. Estimates come with 90% confidence intervals.

::: {.data-entry}
[Starcatcher: the ingredient space of fine dining](https://starcatcher.eu/){.data-title target="_blank"}

Dahlke, J., & Koch, P. (2026). Starcatcher. The ingredient space of fine dining. *Research platform, methods and data appendix*. https://starcatcher.eu

An interactive research atlas built together with Johannes Dahlke. We map more than 150,000 dishes from around 640 MICHELIN-listed kitchens in eight regions in Europe and the US into one ingredient space, using methods from economic complexity, to see which ingredients are rising or fading on menus and what predicts a star. The platform is at an early research stage and the data, built from public sources, are provisional.
